name: vendor.openwop-app.workflows.strategy
description: Strategy operating-rhythm workflows (RFC 0013, ADR 0231). The KR measurement cadence: a weekly check-in nudge that finds measured key results with no recent confirmed check-in and notifies their owners, a metric-sync pass that refreshes every sourced key result from its configured data owner (CRM deal totals, analytics conversions) through the one governed check-in path, and a board-pack pre-read that drafts an MBR/QBR memo into a board-update Document. All THREE are scheduled via the strategy cadence config (GET/PUT /v1/host/openwop-app/strategy/cadence) — no auto-boot jobs. All writes ride ctx.features.strategy.checkIn: agent writes are structurally proposals; sync writes are confirmed only by a human-configured measure.source (fail-closed).
author: openwop-app

chains.label: Strategy: Weekly Check-in Nudge
chains.description: Find measured key results with no confirmed check-in inside the staleness window (default 14 days) across active shared strategies, compose a per-owner digest, and deliver it as a notification deep-linking the Strategy page. Read-only over strategy data — no approval gate needed.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

config.systemPrompt: You are a chief of staff running the strategy operating rhythm. From the stale key-result list, write a SHORT check-in nudge: group by strategy, name each stale key result, and ask its owner for a value + one-line note this week. If the list is empty, say the portfolio is fully checked in. Plain text, no markdown headers.

chains.label: Strategy: Board Pack Pre-read
chains.description: Compose an MBR/QBR-shaped pre-read from the live portfolio: health verdicts with their signals (weighted progress, stale key results, pending agent proposals, execution links), synthesized into a board-update Document and delivered as a notification. Reporting as composition — no dashboard, no parallel store (ADR 0233/0082). Insights-suite variance stays chat-drivable rather than statically composed (a chain must not reference a maybe-off feature's nodes).

orgId.description: The organization whose Documents the board-update memo files into.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

config.systemPrompt: You are a chief of staff writing a board pre-read for {{params.audience}}. From the portfolio health rows and their signals, write a concise MBR/QBR-shaped markdown memo: 1) headline progress (weighted KR progress where measured), 2) strategies at risk or off-track and WHY (use the signals — never invent numbers), 3) stale measurements and pending agent proposals needing decisions, 4) asks. Ground every claim in the provided signals.

documentId.description: The persisted board-update Document (when the documents feature is on).

chains.label: Strategy: Sync Sourced Metrics
chains.description: Refresh every sourced key result from its configured data owner through the governed check-in path (confirmed only by the human-configured measure.source; everything else fail-closed), then summarize the honest synced/skipped matrix as a notification. The run output is the sync-health record.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.
